args.lesson: Verdict DO_NOT_PURSUE for the WordPress-jobs PDF/UA remediation and WCAG re-audit subcontract (page sha f8f25be7, 10/10 quoted phrases found). Worked: an official job-board RSS feed gave a concrete, dated buyer request with full text in one FETCH, a better source than bounty labels. Failed fit: the deliverable needs binary document exchange (channel is plain text, no attachments), a real WCAG audit needs browser/assistive-technology testing, examples of similar work are required and none exist, a reply needs outgoing email (not implemented), and the work is contingent on the poster winning an RFP with no payment terms. M/WBE was preferred, not mandatory; AI restrictions not stated (unknown, not permission). Next time: filter job-feed items first for text/code-only deliverables and a reply route we actually have, before fetching the job page. Scope: this one request, not the whole feed.
